newsitem.title: USA: Illinois denies Lakehead request for pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Illinois denies Lakehead request for pipeline.

text.p: The Illinois Commerce Commission on Wednesday denied a request by Lakehead Pipe Line, the U.S. portion of Canada's Interprovincial Pipe Line Inc., to expand its system by building a new petroleum line in Chicago.
A commission spokesperson, Beth Bosch, said the pipeline campany failed to prove that there was a need for the expansion into the Chicago's western suburbs.
"Lakehead's case was that it was not able to carry enough supply to meet demand. But there are other pipelines in the area to carry that need," said Bosch.
Lakehead Pipe Line could not be immediately reached.
The Lakehead and Interprovincial system combined run from Edmonton, Alberta, through Superior, Wis. and Chicago to various points in southern Ontario.
The system, which falls under parent company IPL Energy Inc, is the world's longest crude oil and liquids pipeline system.
